TS1203: `export =` in an ES module
  at main.ts:3:1

    2 | 
  > 3 | export = config;
        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    4 | 

  This file is an ES module, which exports with `export`; `export =` is TypeScript's CommonJS form.

  Fix: Change the export:
  export = config;
  → export default config;

  Original (deno check):
  │ TS1203 [ERROR]: Export assignment cannot be used when targeting ECMAScript modules. Consider using 'export default' or another module format instead.
  │ export = config;
  │ ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  │     at file:///app/main.ts:3:1
